function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os, glob
allowed = {"off_by_one","mutable_default","shadowed_builtin","wrong_except","integer_division","unclosed_resource"}
d = json.load(open("findings.json"))
files = sorted(os.path.basename(p) for p in glob.glob("src/*.py"))
print("src files:", files)
print("keys    :", sorted(d.keys()))
print("keys match files:", sorted(d.keys()) == files)
bad = {k:v for k,v in d.items() if v not in allowed}
print("off-vocab:", bad)
print("values:", json.dumps(d, indent=0))
EOF"}
